fundamental.summary: V shows no insider buying, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 56 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

risk.summary: Severe VIX crisis (361) and flat yield curve create hostile trading conditions; 56-day earnings window provides some buffer but macro deterioration dominates risk assessment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (12/100) with contrarian buy signal, short-term bullish technicals (AO cross-up, OBV rising, supertrend bullish), and congressional insider purchases 82-92 days ago suggest contrarian opportunity at support.
